meta.title: Marketing coordinator at a multi-location resort retailer
meta.industry: Resort retail, six shops and an online store
meta.blurb: Runs email campaigns, social posts and in-shop signage.

opportunities.quote: About eight competitor sites and two local news sites, a few times a week, by hand.
opportunities.why: You check several competitor sites and local news sites by hand to stay current, which fits a feed-based briefing.
opportunities.patternName: Monitoring news and sources as a daily briefing
opportunities.firstStep: List the sources you check and set alerts for the topics, then read one digest a day.
opportunities.failureMode: Too many alerts and the digest becomes another inbox.

opportunities.quote: many of which are the same hours and shipping questions
opportunities.why: You answer the same hours and shipping questions in comments again and again.
opportunities.firstStep: Collect the ten questions you answered most last month and put the answers on one shared page.
opportunities.failureMode: Answers go stale when the source page is not owned by anyone.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: For "Write social posts", how many posts do you write per week, and where do they go?
options: Drafts go to manager for approval

transcript.question: For "Write social posts", where do the ideas or information for each post come from?
transcript.answer: Mostly from the competitor deals and news I note in my doc a few times a week.

transcript.question: For "Track competitor promotions", where do you find the promotions, and where do your notes end up?
options: Competitor websites, notes in a doc
Competitor emails, notes in a spreadsheet
Social pages, notes in a doc
Mix of sources, shared with the team
transcript.answer: Competitor websites, notes in a doc

transcript.question: For "Track competitor promotions", how many competitors or promotions do you check each week?
transcript.answer: About eight competitor sites and two local news sites, a few times a week, by hand.

transcript.question: For "Check social media comments", roughly how many comments do you go through per week?
For "Check social media comments", where do comments come from, and what do you do with them afterward?
transcript.answer: Facebook/Instagram; reply directly. I answer the about 30 daily comments, many of which are the same hours and shipping questions.
